content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the inability of event probes (eprobes) to handle symbols denoted by "@" correctly, leading to a NULL pointer dereference crash when such symbols were used. This inconsistency with kprobes and uprobes, which can reference various data types including immediate addresses and symbols, resulted in the crash when the event being probed did not have the expected fields. The patch addresses this by allowing eprobes to utilize the "comm" field and handle symbols appropriately, thus preventing the NULL pointer dereference.
